preprocess_image_segmentation: preprocess images and segmentation maps for SAM3 model input with resizing and normalization
generate_crop_boxes: generate crop boxes with sampling points for multi-scale mask prediction on input images
filter_masks: filter predicted masks by IoU score, stability score, and crop edge proximity thresholds
post_process_masks: remove padding and upscale predicted masks back to original image sizes
post_process_instance_segmentation: convert raw SAM3 model outputs into instance segmentation predictions with boxes and binary masks
